newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GERMAN OFFICIALS TALK ABOUT PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN OFFICIALS TALK ABOUT PRIVATISATION.

text.p: The European affairs ministry said on Friday that a delegation of German government officials and businessmen arrived in Lithuania and to talk with officials about privatisation and investment.
"During the meeting with European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene the privatisation process of key enterprises and further prospects were discussed," the ministry said in a statement.

Direct German investments in Lithuania and trade issues were also discussed. Heinrich Kolb, parliamentary state secretary of the German economy ministry, headed the delegation of German bankers and companies.
Andrikiene reassured the delegation that the government was aiming for a stable investment enviroment.
